title: SM64DS Co-op preview.6: pack switches and controller binding repair

tests: 12 Windows component tests, including pack selection persistence and resource loading
Actual final executable: three mixed input slots, pause capture raw controller versus neutral gameplay, focus rejection and capture cancellation
Actual pause handlers: held A does not reopen capture; captured Start does not close pause
Actual pack menu ON/OFF roundtrip; fresh disabled-marker launch restores stock menu
Final source portable front-end CI: all nine jobs passed

notes:
Adds saved **ON/OFF switches for installed resource packs** and repairs **Xbox/controller binding capture from pause-menu controls**. The game now lets the focused binding editor read controller buttons while gameplay input remains blocked; held A/Start presses are consumed after capture.

**Disable a texture pack:** on the title screen, open **Mods → Texture Pack Tools → Enable / Disable Packs**, select the pack and switch it **OFF**, then quit and reopen the game. Use the same menu to enable it again. Pack files and saves stay intact. Changes must be made before starting an adventure.

**Map controls:** open **Options → Controls**, choose the action row and one of its three cells with Left/Right or the mouse, press Enter/A to edit, release the buttons, then press the desired keyboard key or controller button. Escape cancels; Delete clears the selected binding. Choices save automatically.

**Update:** quit the game, replace the EXE in your existing extracted game folder, and keep assets, saves, settings and mods. Friends should update before starting a fresh room. The WGS server and public tunnel need no update. The optional DS Classic Menu pack remains a separate ZIP; extract its ds-classic-menu folder into mods/resource-packs and restart.

The actual executable passed capture/focus/held-button and pack-toggle/fallback checks, 12 local component tests and all nine portable CI jobs. Includes the existing constructor-memory crash repair and seven-player features. This release does not claim to resolve all internet lag or peer-departure pacing. Native Linux/SteamOS/macOS game ports remain in progress; compiler/component tests are not playable releases.

No ROM, cartridge assets, saves, private tunnel credentials or home IP address are bundled.
